name: What kind of maintenance is required for a paver pool deck?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for a paver pool deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paver pool decks are relatively low maintenance. Routine care typically involves sweeping or blowing to remove debris, and occasional rinsing with water. For deeper cleaning, a mild detergent and a stiff brush or power washer can be used to remove stains or algae. We recommend periodic resealing, usually every 2-5 years, to protect the pavers from fading, staining, and to stabilize joint sand, preserving their appearance and extending their lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes regular sweeping, rinsing, and occasional cleaning with detergent. Periodic resealing every 2-5 years is recommended to protect pavers and extend their lifespan.
